newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner to phase out Turner Pictures.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner to phase out Turner Pictures.

text.p: Time Warner Inc., continuing to merge Turner Broadcasting System Inc. into its operations since acquiring it in October, said Thursday it plans to phase out Turner Pictures and fold its projects and employees into Warner Bros.
A Time Warner spokesman said the phase-out is under way. It was not immediately known how long the process would take.

"After months of weighing the options for Turner Pictures, we have determined that moving the Turner Pictures' slate of films to Warner Bros will best serve the projects and be in the best overall interest of the company," Time Warner Vice Chairman R.E. Turner said in a statement.
Time Warner spokesman Edward Adler said the company will not take a restructuring charge as a result of the change.
Time Warner's stock rose 37.5 cents to $40.125 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
